waypoints.name: Twin Lakes (Mono Village) Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US-395 in Bridgeport, take Twin Lakes Road about 13 miles to its end at Mono Village on Upper Twin Lake, about 7,100 ft. Overnight parking is at the resort for a fee, and a Hoover Wilderness permit is required for overnight trips.

waypoints.name: Matterhorn Peak
waypoints.directions: Follow the Horse Creek Trail south up Horse Creek canyon past a talus field to about 9,200 ft, then take the use trail right up steep ground to a small lake on a bench. Continue up slabs to the glacier below the north side of the peak, go a short way up the East Couloir left of the arete to its base, and climb the arete to the summit ridge, trending southwest to the top.
